question: Why can one grain of sand set off an avalanche of any size?
answer: This pile was fed grain by grain until it could take no more, so it sits on the edge of collapse. A square with 4 grains topples, sending one grain to each neighbour, and that can set off a chain reaction. Any single grain can start an avalanche of any size.
move: On the edge, a huge avalanche needs no huge cause: any grain can start one.

web.label: A grid of squares holding grains of sand. Tap any square to drop a grain; a square with 4 grains topples, sending one to each neighbour. Gold squares hold 3. Asks why one grain can set off an avalanche of any size.
